name: Osananajimi no Yaoya no Musume ga, Eros na Taikai ni Shutsujou Shimasu.
original_name: 幼なじみの八百屋の娘が、エロスな大会に出場します。
source:
A millionaire guy Harumitsu offers financial support to the heroine's family,
which is suffering from serious financial problems.
But he requires her to be cucked in exchange for the money.

The protagonist's beloved childhood friend is cucked by "two fathers"!?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE205675.html]Dlsite English[/url]]
translation:
富豪春光向女主角的家庭提供经济援助，以解决他们严重的财务问题。
但作为金钱交换，他要求她被戴绿帽。

主人公深爱的青梅竹马，竟要被“两位父亲”戴绿帽！？

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE205675.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
